# The White Cakes - Cebu

> The White Cakes - Cebu (also called White Cakes and The White Cakes) is a made-to-order cloud kitchen in Lahug, Cebu. There is no storefront, no walk-in counter, and no street address is published. Pickup is arranged after an order is confirmed. Delivery covers Cebu City, Mandaue City, and Lapu-Lapu City.

## Brand

- Name: The White Cakes - Cebu
- Alternate names: White Cakes; The White Cakes
- Website: https://www.thewhitecakes.com/
- Claimed Cebu business profile: https://mycebu.directory/business/the-white-cakes-cebu
- Email: info@thewhitecakes.com
- WhatsApp: +63 947 438 2632
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thewhitecakescebu/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596567450476
- Logo: https://www.thewhitecakes.com/assets/white-cakes-logo.png

## Services

Hand-finished buttercream cakes, baked for a named date. Signature designs are Signature Marble (6-inch), Bouquet Cake, and Bento Cake (4-inch). Also custom celebration cakes, birthday cakes, anniversary and gift cakes, intimate wedding and engagement cakes, and corporate or office orders. Flavours are chocolate, vanilla, ube, mango, and red velvet.

Launch prices in PHP are published until January 15, 2027 inclusive. The regular price is what the shop charges after that date. Custom designs are starting prices; the final price depends on the design. Bouquet cakes are price on request. A 50% deposit confirms the order. Perishable custom cakes are not returnable. This site does not list reviews or ratings.

## Launch prices (PHP)

Valid until January 15, 2027 inclusive. Label: Launch price — until January 15, 2027.

- Bento cake (4 inch): regular 599, launch 449
- 6-inch custom cake: regular 1799, launch 1399 (starting at)
- 8-inch custom cake: regular 2599, launch 1999 (starting at)
- Christmas vintage cake (6 inch): regular 1650, Christmas special 650 until December 25, 2026
- 2-tier custom cake: regular 4299, launch 3399 (starting at)
- Bouquet cake: price on request (no published price)

## How to order

Orders need at least three days' notice. Tell us the design, flavour, date, words for the top, and whether you want arranged pickup in Cebu City or delivery. For delivery, send a full address, a landmark, and a person who will receive the cake. We reply within 24 hours.

- Order form: https://www.thewhitecakes.com/order/
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/639474382632

## Delivery areas

- Cebu City: https://www.thewhitecakes.com/cake-delivery-cebu-city/
- Mandaue City: https://www.thewhitecakes.com/cake-delivery-mandaue/
- Lapu-Lapu City, including Mactan: https://www.thewhitecakes.com/cake-delivery-lapu-lapu/
